# TinySoundFont

`tsf.h` and `LICENSE` from https://github.com/schellingb/TinySoundFont at commit
853a0a171759f1ddba0de1442133a75912bbeffa, unchanged. MIT licence.

HIRAKU uses it in `hiraku-midi` (runtime/midi/player.cpp), the launcher's MIDI player, to play
music with a SoundFont where Keyboardmania's synth card isn't there.
